models.horizon_blind_physics: first-passage with fixed 24h reference volatility for every row

models.horizon_aware_rules: aware physics plus the same coefficient schema over selected-duration context
models.horizon_aware_interactions: aware rules plus continuous log-duration interactions in one model

selection: ridge on calibration; choose eligible time-aware candidate on rule_test; open final_test once after freezing
candidate_gate: positive mean log-loss and Brier improvement on calibration
positive mean log-loss and Brier improvement on rule_test
